_comment: Template: Generate SHACL constraints from Excel + RDFS profile.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar excel2shacl --config this-file.json
_note_rdfsFile: RDFS profile .rdf file. Provides the class and property vocabulary that the Excel constraints reference. Use the augmented RDFS format exported by cimsyntaxgen.
_note_excelFile: Excel .xlsx file containing constraint definitions. Must have a data sheet at sheet index 0. May optionally have a 'Config' sheet for namespace declarations — if present, namespace columns from Config override the nsPrefix/nsUri/cimsNamespace/cimNamespace fields below.
_note_output: Where to write the generated SHACL Turtle (.ttl) file.
_note_nsPrefix: Namespace prefix for generated shapes. Appears in sh:NodeShape URIs. Examples: 'eu-nc', 'cim17-eq-shapes', 'custom-constraints'.
_note_nsUri: Namespace URI for generated shapes. Must end with # or /. Used as the base for sh:NodeShape and sh:PropertyShape URIs.
_note_cimsNamespace: CIMS extensions namespace used to interpret RDFS metadata (multiplicities, stereotypes). Rarely needs changing from the default.
_note_cimNamespace: CIM namespace. For CGMES 3.0/CIM17: http://iec.ch/TC57/CIM100#. For CGMES 2.4/CIM16: http://iec.ch/TC57/2013/CIM-schema-cim16#.
